content.title: Rita's celebrating first day of spring with free Italian ice, customers can guess Mystery Peeps flavor - 6abc Philadelphia
content.text: Ritas Italian iceRita's celebrating first day of spring with free Italian ice, new mystery Peeps flavorBy6abc Digital Staff Friday, March 20, 2026 11:08AMCustomers can welcome the return of warmer weather with a free 6 oz. cup of Rita's Italian Ice at locations across the region on Friday.Customers can welcome the return of warmer weather with a free 6 oz. cup of Rita's Italian Ice at locations across the region on Friday.PHILADELPHIA (WPVI) -- It's a Philadelphia-area tradition. Rita's is giving away free water ice to celebrate the first day of spring!On Friday, customers can welcome the return of warmer weather with a free 6 oz. cup at locations across the region.You can choose from signature flavors like lemon, cherry, and mango, or try Rita's new flavor, Mystery Peeps Italian Ice.It's inspired by another Pennsylvania company, Bethlehem-based JustBorn, which makes those iconic marshmallow Peeps treats.Rita's is allowing customers to guess what the Mystery Peeps flavor is, with a chance to win prizes, including free water ice for a year.To guess which flavor you think the Mystery Peeps Italian Ice is, visit: RitasIce.com/peeps.Report a correction or typoCopyright © 2026 WPVI-TV.
